summary: Frontend-only regression testing of LION.STATS slip persistence + double-chance dialog fixes. All 6 requested scenarios pass: (Bug 1) slip persists across navigation and matches list is not emptied; (Bug 1b) dedupe by matchId works — clicking again removes the leg and no duplicates were created; (Bug 2) double-chance card opens the pick-market-dialog with the correct title 'What did you play?' and options pick-option-home / pick-option-home_or_draw, and the saved slip leg has pick='home_or_draw' and pickName='<Team> or Draw'; (Bug 2b) portfolio-stake-modal on a double-chance match shows portfolio-pick-market and an editable portfolio-odds-input, saved bet has the typed odds; (Bug 2c) legWins() logic verified in-page: home_or_draw wins on a draw (True), plain home loses on a draw (False); (Regression) straight 'HOME/AWAY WIN' cards add to slip directly WITHOUT a dialog and their portfolio modal hides pick-market and odds-input. No console errors, BET SLIP pill updated after adds.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug 2c (settlement on real finished DC fixture) could not be exercised end-to-end because the current window had no finished 'or Draw' fixture. The unit-level assertion of legWins() (home_or_draw + draw -> WON, home + draw -> LOST) was verified in-browser and matches PortfolioContext.autoSettle wiring. Consider adding a backend/dev endpoint to force a match into 'finished' state for full e2e coverage of autoSettle.
AddToSlipButton.jsx dialog uses a fixed inset-0 wrapper without focus trap or Escape handler — nice-to-have but not blocking.

removeFromSlip filters by matchId only, but addToSlip dedupes by matchId OR team key. If two feeds have different ids for the same match and only the 'other id' was added, clicking In-slip on the first-feed card won't remove the leg (mismatch of matchId). Not observed in this run, but consider aligning removeFromSlip with the same dedupe key.
test_credentials: Pro-monthly bearer token from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test-pro-monthly-token) used to unlock full Matches grid. Guest also verified (free tier, 3 cards).
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage keys (moka_bet_slip, moka_portfolio_bets, moka_session_token) cleared between scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://teams-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Login: localStorage.setItem('moka_session_token','test-pro-monthly-token') then reload. Verified DC fixture: live_af_1575175 (SC Paderborn 07 vs 1899 Hoffenheim, 'Home or Draw'). Verified straight fixture: live_af_1593319 (Kalamata vs Panathinaikos, 'Away Win'). AddToPortfolioButton is only rendered on the /analysis/:id detail page, NOT on /matches list cards — that is expected. Bug 2c full e2e still not covered because no DC match in current window is 'finished'; only logic-level verification was possible.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 was caused by the backend rate limiter returning 429 -> Matches list came back empty on re-render so the 'In slip' state visually disappeared. Fix: MatchesPage.jsx now keeps previous entries on failed refresh (line ~75) and the backend rate limit was relaxed / cached GETs exempted. Bug 2 was caused by autoSettle comparing r.outcome === pick strictly, so a 'home_or_draw' pick failed on a real 'draw'. Fix: PortfolioContext.autoSettle now uses legWins() with WINNING_OUTCOMES mapping (home_or_draw -> [home, draw]). Both fixes confirmed working.
